A personal exploration of AI’s limits

The limits of AI.

10.2026 · MindFlow

Offline psychotherapy.
Locally on an iPhone.

Can AI support people in distress appropriately — entirely without the cloud?

I built a local iPhone app, personally developed example responses and adapted models using SFT and DPO. The technology became faster. Reliable conversational understanding remained the central challenge.
